_meta.feature: Regulatory Monitoring (P5) → Applicability engine, the full set of laws, regulations, guidelines and standards applicable to each product of the pharmaceutical demo tenant
_meta.purpose: TENANT DATA. For each of the 4 Byrsa Pharma products, the references the applicability engine has determined to apply, why, with what confidence, which version the tenant holds, and which compliance gap each one drives. Also records references the engine explicitly ruled OUT, the noise-filtering half of the story.
_meta.relationship_to_catalog: regulation_id values reuse 05_Demo_Data/regulatory_reference_catalog.json (84-entry global catalog). References not present there are supplied in `catalog_extensions` and should be merged into the global catalog.
_meta.companion_file: applicability_use_cases.json: three scripted applicability scenarios built on this matrix.
_meta.tenant: tnt_byrsa-pharma: Byrsa Pharma S.A. (fictional Tunisian generic-medicines manufacturer)
_meta.scenario_note: DEMO DATA: fictional tenant and products. Regulatory instruments are real unless flagged is_fabricated_for_demo.
_meta.scoping_note: ICH M7 nitrosamine expectations extend to every medicinal product with a chemically synthesised active substance. This dataset scopes the nitrosamine assessment to Glucoryl 850, the only product whose API belongs to a documented at-risk class, so the demo narrative stays on one product instead of four.

legal_status_legend.INGESTIBLE: Public legal text. Qurelio ingests the full text and runs the compliance engine on it directly.
legal_status_legend.REFERENCE_ONLY: Copyrighted paid standard or pharmacopoeia. Selectable for monitoring/assignment; Qurelio shows number + scope only. To analyse, the tenant uploads their OWN licensed copy (liability shift).
legal_status_legend.USER_UPLOAD: Reuse licensing unconfirmed (national gazettes / MENA). Not hosted by Qurelio; the tenant uploads the text and accepts full legal liability before analysis.

schema.regulation_id: Stable key: reused from the global catalog where the entry exists there.
schema.role: What this reference governs for this product (Market access | GMP | Quality/specifications | Labelling | Packaging | Supply chain | Export).
schema.applicability_score: 0–1: how strongly the reference applies to this product (engine output).
schema.confidence_score: 0–1: engine confidence in the applicability determination itself.
schema.verdict: APPLICABLE | NOT_APPLICABLE | CONDITIONAL: CONDITIONAL means it applies only if a stated condition holds.
schema.assignment_source: USER (assigned by the tenant) | ONBOARDING (auto-assigned from the company profile) | ENGINE_DETECTED (engine found it and the user accepted) | NOT_ASSIGNED (engine says it applies but it is not on the product record).
schema.tenant_version_held: The edition/consolidation recorded on the product record.
schema.current_version: The edition/consolidation in force on the as_of_date.
schema.version_drift_days: Days since the in-force date of the current version, when the tenant still holds an earlier one.
schema.linked_gaps: gap ids from the product's product.json that this reference produces.
schema.linked_change_events: monitoring change-event ids affecting this reference.

detected_missing_references.reference: Excipients in the labelling and package leaflet of medicinal products for human use
detected_missing_references.why_it_must_apply: The finished-product composition contains four excipients that carry mandatory route-specific warnings for the cutaneous route: cetostearyl alcohol (70 mg/g), methyl parahydroxybenzoate (1.5 mg/g), propyl parahydroxybenzoate (0.5 mg/g) and sodium sulfite (2.0 mg/g). Propylene glycol (100 mg/g) is named in the SmPC without its warning text. The reference that defines those warnings is not on the product record.

evidence.ref: Part C: artwork check, 4 warnings absent
§4: three contact-dermatitis PV reports closed as expected

detected_missing_references.consequence_if_not_applied: The labelling gap gap-myc-01 has no governing reference on the product record, so no obligation set is generated, no artwork check runs on future revisions, and the finding cannot be tracked to closure.
detected_missing_references.recommended_action: Assign the reference to Mycozan 2 % and re-run the compliance evaluation; the engine will emit 5 labelling obligations and link them to gap-myc-01.

detected_missing_references.why_flagged: Tinea corporis and cutaneous candidosis occur in paediatric patients and the SmPC sets no lower age limit, but no paediatric-specific data or excipient acceptability assessment exists for the paraben and propylene glycol content.
detected_missing_references.recommended_action: Human review: decide whether a paediatric age limit or an excipient acceptability statement is needed.

ruled_out.reason: Non-sterile semi-solid for cutaneous use; no sterility requirement.
No clinical trial; topical generic supported by IVRT and Q1/Q2 sameness.
